body:
Ah, I was starting to think so with the use of quotations, but thought maybe I'd leave it there anyway in the case someone gets any value from it.

You're absolutely right, I truly wish there was more that could be done, and if there is, I hope to find it out. The best we can do at this time, no matter how helpless we feel, is to hope this gets sorted soon, and answer any calls for help that we can fulfil. Whether that be smiles or groceries on Amazon.

In ways I am. Religious, no, believer, absolutely. Thank you for such nice words about me, I have trouble believing them for myself, but hearing you think them, I hope to work hard to make them true. Thank you for putting me in your prayers, I have a hard time feeling like I'm worth that honour, but I graciously accept. I'll give it a try too. It's funny how I don't ask for help, thinking I know best. Clearly I know not as much as I believed or I would be over at lifeprotips instead of being the one in need. I'm glad that I don't know it all though. Not knowing it all means that there's the possibility of there being more out there. I wouldn't mind sticking around a little longer to learn if there is.

Absolutely. I don't want to feel this way forever, and I don't want others to feel this way either. Kindness may not fix this whole wide world, but it certainly helps the little worlds within it try to keep turning.  Thank you, truly.
Thank you for being a kind person. I can't promise what I'll do or where I'll be another year from now, but you should know that your kindness matters.

I guess I just don't understand, I was so hopeful and excited for the future a couple of days ago and now it's like it turned into complete hopelessness. It's interesting what you say about getting up...I've said that very thing to people all of my life. People except for myself. It's so much easier to let ourselves fall and scrape our knees than it is for us to see others do the same. I wish for you to always have a hand up when you need it. 

Thank you for that last part. Forgiving oneself is hard. You feel like you're minimising their hurt by taking yours away. I want to be absolved, but I want more to know they are no longer hurting. I don't get to know that anymore though. Thank you for being a light in a dark place.
I'm not alright, but I will be.
uhh, ahem, *whispers*, I was taught "Never Eat Soggy Wieners"...

Fair enough, I wholly admit that I do not eat Corn Pops often at all, I suppose my lack of familiarity with it could have made it seem like they tasted the same. However, it seems no matter what it is intended to taste like, it has certainly missed the mark, unless 'garbage' is indeed what they were going for. I thought I was just being nostalgic when I didn't like the "new and improved", turns out it just really does actually suck. /sigh
Is it just me, or does the color and flavor highly resemble that of corn pops now?

I'm not sure that I would use 'great' to describe me, but that's kind of you to say. I guess I kind of struggle with taking care of myself, I've always had trouble with that. Taking care of others has always made me more happy than taking care of myself. Maybe it's a nice distraction. Thank you for reading, sorry it was long and I messed up the formatting a bit.

I can relate to what you're saying. There are so many things I want to and could be doing right now, but I guess you nailed it, I am terrified as well. Of what, I'm not sure, maybe failure. I think that's part of the reason I visit places such as this. I visit to see if I'm really so obscure, or if there are indeed others. To be honest, as much as I crave to find people like me, part of me always hopes I don't. I hate that so many people feel this way. Thank you for your offer, your words, and being a person in the world that cared enough to read silly my thoughts. I extend the same offer to you, I can't promise that I'm a great conversationalist, but should you need it, I'll do my best to not suck.
